```{r}
T_obs <- 200
c_vec <- c(2.5, 1.5)
A_1 <- matrix(c(0.45, -0.15,
                -0.35, 0.30), nrow = 2)
A_2 <- matrix(c(0.05, -0.05,
                -0.05, 0.03), nrow = 2)
A_3 <- matrix(c(0.10, 0.04,
                -0.06, 0.08), nrow = 2)
A_4 <- matrix(c(0.05, -0.02,
                0.03, 0.04), nrow = 2)
Sigma <- matrix(c(1.0, 0.1,
                  0.1, 1.0), nrow = 2)

models <- list(
  "VAR(2)" = list(A_1, A_2),
  "VAR(3)" = list(A_1, A_2, A_3),
  "VAR(4)" = list(A_1, A_2, A_3, A_4)
)

K <- length(c_vec)

companion <- rbind(
  cbind(A_1, A_2),
  cbind(diag(K), matrix(0, nrow = K, ncol = K))
)
Mod(eigen(companion)$values)
```

```{r}
var_gamma0 <- function(A, Sigma) {
  K  <- nrow(Sigma)
  p  <- length(A)
  Kp <- K * p
  F  <- matrix(0, Kp, Kp)
  F[1:K, ] <- do.call(cbind, A)
  if (p > 1) F[(K + 1):Kp, 1:(Kp - K)] <- diag(Kp - K)
  Q  <- matrix(0, Kp, Kp)
  Q[1:K, 1:K] <- Sigma
  matrix(solve(diag(Kp^2) - kronecker(F, F), as.vector(Q)), Kp, Kp)[1:K, 1:K]
}

var <- var_gamma0(list(A_1, A_2), Sigma)
```

```{r}
var_r2 <- function(Gamma0, Sigma) {
  R2_eq <- 1 - diag(Sigma) / diag(Gamma0)
  list(
    R2_eq = R2_eq,
    R2_mean = mean(R2_eq),
    R2_det = 1 - det(Sigma) / det(Gamma0),
    R2_trace = 1 - sum(diag(Sigma)) / sum(diag(Gamma0))
  )
}

Sigma <- matrix(c(1.0, 0.8,
                  0.8, 1.0), nrow = 2)

lapply(models, function(A) var_r2(var_gamma0(A, Sigma), Sigma))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

make_Sigma <- function(rho, var_ratio) {
  sd <- c(1, sqrt(var_ratio))
  diag(sd) %*% matrix(c(1, rho, rho, 1), nrow = 2) %*% diag(sd)
}

sigma_grid <- expand_grid(
  rho       = seq(-0.9, 0.9, by = 0.05),
  var_ratio = c(0.25, 1, 4)
)

r2_df <- sigma_grid %>%
  mutate(r2 = map2(rho, var_ratio, function(r, v) {
    S <- make_Sigma(r, v)
    imap(models, function(A, nm) {
      out <- var_r2(var_gamma0(A, S), S)
      tibble(
        model   = nm,
        variant = c("R2 eq. 1", "R2 eq. 2", "R2 mean", "R2 det", "R2 trace"),
        value   = c(out$R2_eq, out$R2_mean, out$R2_det, out$R2_trace)
      )
    }) |>
      list_rbind()
  })) %>%
  unnest(r2)

p_r2_sigma <- r2_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(rho, value, colour = variant)) +
  geom_line() +
    facet_grid(model ~ var_ratio,
             labeller = labeller(var_ratio = label_both, model = label_value)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = expression("Innovation correlation " * rho),
       y = expression(R^2), colour = NULL,
       title = expression("Population " * R^2 * " variants by innovation covariance"),
       subtitle = expression("Columns: " * sigma[2]^2 / sigma[1]^2 * ";  " * sigma[1]^2 == 1)) +
  theme_minimal()

p_r2_sigma
```

```{r}
scale_cross <- function(A_list, s12, s21) {
  map(A_list, function(A) {
    A[1, 2] <- s12 * A[1, 2]
    A[2, 1] <- s21 * A[2, 1]
    A
  })
}

is_stable <- function(A_list) {
  K  <- nrow(A_list[[1]])
  p  <- length(A_list)
  Kp <- K * p
  F  <- matrix(0, Kp, Kp)
  F[1:K, ] <- do.call(cbind, A_list)
  if (p > 1) F[(K + 1):Kp, 1:(Kp - K)] <- diag(Kp - K)
  all(Mod(eigen(F)$values) < 1)
}

scenarios <- tribble(
  ~scenario,            ~s12, ~s21,
  "as specified",          1,    1,
  "no cross-lags",         0,    0,
  "cross-lags flipped",   -1,   -1,
  "mixed signs",           1,   -1
)

r2_cross <- expand_grid(scenarios,
                        model = names(models),
                        rho   = seq(-0.9, 0.9, by = 0.05)) %>%
  mutate(scenario = fct_inorder(scenario),
         A        = pmap(list(model, s12, s21),
                         \(m, a, b) scale_cross(models[[m]], a, b)),
         stable   = map_lgl(A, is_stable)) %>%
  filter(stable) %>%                      # unstable scenario/model combos are dropped
  mutate(r2 = map2(A, rho, function(A, r) {
    S   <- matrix(c(1, r, r, 1), nrow = 2) # variance ratio = 1
    out <- var_r2(var_gamma0(A, S), S)
    tibble(
      variant = c("R2 eq. 1", "R2 eq. 2", "R2 mean", "R2 det", "R2 trace"),
      value   = c(out$R2_eq, out$R2_mean, out$R2_det, out$R2_trace)
    )
  })) %>%
  select(-A) %>%
  unnest(r2)

p_r2_cross <- r2_cross %>%
  ggplot(aes(rho, value, colour = variant)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(model ~ scenario) +
  labs(x = expression("Innovation correlation " * rho),
       y = expression(R^2), colour = NULL,
       title = expression(R^2 * " variants by cross-lag structure"),
       subtitle = expression(sigma[1]^2 == sigma[2]^2 * " = 1")) +
  theme_minimal()

p_r2_cross
```
